bugReport:
# Customer bug report — #4821

**From:** Maya Chen
**Subject:** "Buy 3 get 10% off" didn't apply

I ordered exactly 3 Navy Hoodies. Banner says Buy 3 get 10% off. Cart charged full price. Friend who bought 4 got the discount.
